# AliceLabs

AliceLabs offers web development, process automation and MVP development. The website presents service scopes and prepares a project inquiry in the visitor's email application. It does not send inquiries or take payments automatically.

- Website: https://www.alicelabs.site/
- Contact: contact@alicelabs.site
- Source organization: https://github.com/alicelabs-llc
- Privacy: https://www.alicelabs.site/privacy/
- Terms: https://www.alicelabs.site/terms/

Pricing, timing and third-party costs are agreed in a project proposal. The site does not expose an operational API or promise measurable commercial results.
